pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed several of these words from European languages, so the spelling matches English in some cases. Over time the Turkish meanings changed, so the same spelling now points to a different English meaning.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word that looks exactly like the English word 'pasta' means 'cake' in Turkish, not the noodle dish. A Turkish speaker who asks for 'pasta' in an English-speaking place may be understood as ordering noodles.
